protocol.role: post-outcome deterministic mechanism diagnosis on all four source-derived support regressions
protocol.registration_context: the source shadow outcomes are already observed; registration freezes the diagnostic execution and does not make it confirmatory
protocol.target_selection: all and only source state_changes with support_outcome=regressed; must equal state indices 424,425,437,438

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

source_rule.price_vectors: all lambda_c in {0, Q_c}; 2^3=8 fixed masks
source_rule.reduced_weight: Q dot requirements - lambda dot requirements, clipped below by idle value zero
source_rule.threshold_cap: min(v4 weighted cap, v4 coordinate cap, min_lambda[lambda dot residual + suffix reduced max + (remaining-1) global reduced max])
source_rule.duration_thresholds: same effective-duration threshold set as v4
source_rule.unchanged: homogeneous seeds, paid attempts, feasibility, consider tie break, threshold set and search tree
source_rule.interpretation: integrated bound-and-heap-expansion composite; not a sidecar certificate
source_rule.admissibility: weak duality for every nonnegative price vector; the zero mask reproduces the v4 weighted cap

protocol.first_divergence_definition: after the ten paid seeds, the first paid attempt whose popped logical prefix or ordered choice differs; a bound-value change alone is not a search divergence
protocol.logical_prefix: indices, service, numerator, duration and next_index; lane-order permutations remain distinct search prefixes

classification.early_pruning: the legacy top is absent from the residual frontier because its new bound was at most the common incumbent while its old bound was larger
classification.heap_reprioritization: both competing tops are live in both pre-pop frontiers, but the old and new heap keys select different prefixes

protocol.validation: independently rerun the frozen legacy and residual K26 selectors and match their registered source checkpoints exactly
protocol.completion_rule: status PASS means all four targets were classified with valid frontier evidence and both K26 checkpoints reproduced; it is not an algorithm advancement decision
protocol.stopping_rule: run the fixed paired K26 diagnosis once on the four targets and stop after reporting the first divergence in each; do not add states, budgets, masks, hybrid selectors or trajectory outcomes
protocol.prohibited_in_this_stage: arrival generation, trajectory simulation, RNG, sidecar or hybrid selection, new experiments, tuning and paper edits

limitations: The four states were selected because the source shadow regressed. The trace identifies the first causal search-order change in those states; it does not validate a sidecar on the other 4,999 states or on full trajectories.
next_step: separately preregister a fixed-state sidecar design that retains the legacy heap priority and applies the tighter bound only to safe pruning and certification
